tasks.subject: Task 0: Stock status helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extract and test the pure `getStockStatus` function.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/components/helpers.ts`
- Create: `src/app/app/components/helpers.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] returns critical when available <= 0
- [ ] returns low when 0 < available < reorderPoint
- [ ] returns ok when available >= reorderPoint or reorderPoint is 0

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/app/app/components/helpers.ts","src/app/app/components/helpers.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"npx vitest run src/app/app/components/helpers.test.ts --pool threads --maxWorkers 1","acceptanceCriteria":["getStockStatus returns critical when available <= 0","getStockStatus returns low when 0 < available < reorderPoint","getStockStatus returns ok when available >= reorderPoint or reorderPoint is 0"]}
```
